course.title: Reinforced Concrete Structures - I
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: An isolated T- beam is to be designed to carry a uniformly distributed load on a 20 ft simple span. The total ultimate moment at mid-span due to all loads is 6000 kipsinch. Concrete dimensions as governed by web shear and clearance conditions are $\mathtt { b } = 4 5$ inch, $b w = 1 0$ inch, and ${ \mathsf { d } } = 2 0$ inch. What tensile reinforcement is required at mid-span, if $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 5 0 0$ psi and $f _ { y } = 6 0 { , } 0 0 0$ psi? Design the beam by USD method and show reinforcement details.
